messages:
nina.ops: RCA is published: https://internal.redwood/rca/2839123456. Short summary: a misapplied feature flag caused an inconsistent tokenizer config for one model variant, leading to malformed token boundaries and 5xx churn for ~12 minutes. We reverted the flag and rolled forward a corrected config. Action items are in the doc 1; owners, please ack by EOD.

deploy-bot: Deployment timeline: 16:40 feature flag enable -> 16:46 errors spike -> 16:52 rollback -> 17:00 fix applied -> 17:05 system stabilized. Attachments: stack traces + sample failed requests.

chris.eng: I'll take the "flag gating + preflight" item. Plan: add an automated preflight that validates tokenizer outputs across a canonical prompt set and fail the flag enable if diffs exceed threshold. ETA: Tue 2024-03-05.

lina.sre: I'll own the "observability + alert tuning" item. I'll add a metric for tokenizer token-rate variance and create an alert to trigger before 5xx rates spike. Proposed check-in: Wed 2024-03-06 09:00 PT.

alex.prod: I'll draft the customer note for CSMs. Short, non-technical. Will share in this thread for a quick review.

miles.support: FYI I fielded ~7 tickets during the window; most customers were informational. Will include link to RCA in replies.

nina.ops: Office hours to walk through the RCA: Thu 2024-02-29 10:00 PT. Calendar invite sent to #all-hands. Please add questions here beforehand.

chris.eng: ✅

lina.sre: ✅ (confirming check-in)

alex.prod: ✅ will post draft by EOD

miles.support: ✅

nina.ops: Reminder: include PR links, test results, and screenshots of alert thresholds when you post updates. We'll close items after verification and one-week watch.
